title: scabiosa succisa var. glabrata
intro: Scabiosa succisa var. glabrata, commonly known as Field Scabious, is a perennial plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering relief from allergies, respiratory issues, and inflammation, as well as providing health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Field Scabious include its ability to act as an anti-histamine, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it a potential remedy for conditions such as hay fever, bronchitis, and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Field Scabious include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
